Lower Text: [On Deletion] If deleted outside of a battle, your opponent trashes 1 card in their hand.
Upper Text: [On Play] Suspend 1 of your opponent's level 6 or lower Digimon. Then, by placing this Digimon as the bottom digivolution card of 1 of your Digimon with [Ravemon] in its name, that Digimon may attack an opponent's Digimon.
